resources.string: Bulbul is a voice dictation app. It uses Accessibility to notice when you tap into a text field in another app, to read that field so your dictation is typed at the cursor, to type the dictated text into it, and to notice for a few seconds afterwards if you correct a word so it can suggest a dictionary entry. Text it reads from other apps stays on your phone. Audio is recorded only while you hold or tap the floating bubble.
